summary:
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — Major refactor of the IDEA/ALLEGRO vertex detector introducing FCC-SEED as an option across all detectors, updating vertex/silicon wrapper pitches and adding new `CLD_o5_v01` and `CLD_o1_v09` variants ([#612](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/612)). The ALLEGRO HCAL Endcap pseudo-layer position calculation has been fixed for PandoraPFA compatibility ([#666](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/666)). Additional fixes to the `dd4hep2root` visualization utility ensure predefined ROOT colors are correctly mapped/cached ([#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662), [#667](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/667)).
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — Multiple ALLEGRO reconstruction chain improvements: TRAPPIST π⁰ identification is now enabled by default for both topological and sliding-window clusters in `o1_v03` and `o2_v01` ([#392](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/392)); vertex/silicon-wrapper resolutions were updated to 3 µm / 5 ns and 50 µm/√12 to match the new baseline ([#384](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/384)); STT digitization is now available and integrated into the track finder for `ALLEGRO_o2_v01` ([#388](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/388), [#396](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/396)); and the `DCHdigi_v02` → `WireTrackerDigi_v01` rename crash was patched ([#395](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/395)). Also, IDEA Delphes/EDM4hep cards were restored and ZH/ZZ/WW Pythia8 cards refreshed to their winter2023 versions ([#393](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/393)).
- **[hep-fcc/k4RecCalorimeter](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter)** — Adds the full seeded ECAL clustering chain for the IDEA o2 dual-readout calorimeter, including `CreateOpticalCaloCells`, calorimeter- and track-driven seeding, seed merging, and grower algorithms, along with a new CI reconstruction test ([#271](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/271)).
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker)** — Renames `DCHdigi_v02` to the collider-agnostic `WireTrackerDigi_v01`, supporting both drift-chamber and straw-tube geometries via a new `isSTT` Gaudi property (with a backward-compatible alias, subsequently fixed in [#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/103)) ([#100](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/100)).
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — Adds support for the Gaudi 41 `EventContext` data-handle API, required for upstream Gaudi CI ([#432](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/432)). Simplifies `OverlayTiming`'s background particle index mapping (replacing per-frame maps with direct offset indexing, giving both a correctness fix for dropped daughter relations and a measurable speed-up) ([#429](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/429)). Also adds a `--evt-max` alias to `k4run` ([#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431)).
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — Switches to the upstream `ActsPlugins::EDM4hepUtil` converter, fixing the track-state covariance layout to match `edm4hep::TrackParams` order (a correctness fix for downstream consumers), and removing several hundred lines of local conversion code ([#95](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/95)). Adds an edge-sorting/flipping stage to align GNN track-finding with the training convention ([#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/103)) and a pass-through `ClassifiedEdgePrinting` stage for pipeline debugging ([#105](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/105)).
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes)** — Now stores photon pointing angles (`ITheta`/`IPhi`) with their direction error and hit position errors from Delphes, enabling downstream pointing-resolution studies (requires Delphes ≥ 3.5.2pre02) ([#161](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/161)).
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — Makes the EDM4hep reader's vertex handling consistent with `HepMC3EventReader` by using the end vertex of parent-less particles (defaulting to origin), resolving inconsistencies between HepMC and EDM4hep intermediate layers between Pythia and ddsim ([#1684](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1684)). Removes the CSG-based DDCAD ASSIMP exporter because ROOT made `RCsg` private (functionality to be reintroduced via a public-API implementation) ([#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681)).
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — Hides the deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload from Cling/cppyy, which was selecting the wrong overload in Python ([#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524)).
- **[hep-fcc/root2gltf](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf)** — Shrinks children volumes overlapping their parents so distinct geometry envelopes render correctly, and improves conversion defaults (numFaces reduced to 1000, full opacity) ([#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15)).
